decisions.reason: Quantified government adoption and connections to over 30 APIS schemes keep results well above aspiration levels, and the product is central to the firm's aviation security business, so there is no reason to search for other uses of its resources.
The low-cost cyber awareness module sits close to the certified-trainer offer and meets growing demand, so the expanding firm's slack easily carries it despite no reported results.

Behaviour analysis builds on the firm's specialist detection capabilities and supports its innovation strategy at airports, so slack from expansion lets management tolerate uncertain results for another period, though the lack of evidence keeps the risk of withdrawal moderate.
